final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 as region, COUNT(*) as count_val FROM `order` o JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp di ON a.account_id = di.account_id AND di.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client c ON di.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(count_val) as avg_count FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.account_id, s1.region, s1.count_val, s1.count_val - s2.avg_count as diff FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2), step4 AS (SELECT region, AVG(diff) as avg_diff FROM step3 GROUP BY region) SELECT s3.account_id, s3.region, s3.count_val, s3.diff, s3.diff - s4.avg_diff as final_diff FROM step3 s3 JOIN step4 s4 ON s3.region = s4.region WHERE s3.diff > s4.avg_diff ORDER BY final_diff DESC LIMIT 10
